14.3.title: Monopole Antenna Directivity Calculation on Ground Plane
14.3.title_cn: 接地平面单极子天线方向性系数计算
14.3.description: A monopole antenna on a large ground plane has a far-field pattern function given by $F_\theta(\theta, \phi) = A \sin \theta$ for $0 \leq \theta \leq 90^\circ$. The radiated field is zero for $90^\circ \leq \theta \leq 180^\circ$. Find the directivity (in dB) of this antenna.
14.3.description_cn: 一个位于大型接地平面上的单极子天线，其远场方向图函数为 $F_\theta(\theta, \phi) = A \sin \theta$，其中 $0 \leq \theta \leq 90^\circ$，在 $90^\circ \leq \theta \leq 180^\circ$ 范围内辐射场为零。求该天线的方向性系数（以 dB 表示）。

angular_range.description: Radiation exists only in upper hemisphere

steps.title: Main Beam Direction Location
steps.explanation: $\sin\theta$ achieves maximum at $\theta=90^\circ$ within the range $0^\circ \leq \theta \leq 90^\circ$
steps.explanation_cn: 在 $0^\circ \leq \theta \leq 90^\circ$ 范围内，$\sin\theta$ 在 $\theta=90^\circ$ 处取得最大值

steps.title: Directivity Calculation
steps.explanation: Substitute $F(\theta,\phi)=A\sin\theta$, $F_{\text{max}}=A$, compute integral: $\int_0^{2\pi} d\phi \int_0^{\pi/2} A^2 \sin^3\theta \, d\theta = 2\pi A^2 \cdot \frac{2}{3} = \frac{4\pi A^2}{3}$, then $D = \frac{4\pi A^2}{4\pi A^2/3} = 3$
steps.explanation_cn: 代入 $F(\theta,\phi)=A\sin\theta$，$F_{\text{max}}=A$，计算积分：$\int_0^{2\pi} d\phi \int_0^{\pi/2} A^2 \sin^3\theta \, d\theta = 2\pi A^2 \cdot \frac{2}{3} = \frac{4\pi A^2}{3}$，则 $D = \frac{4\pi A^2}{4\pi A^2/3} = 3$

steps.title: Directivity in Decibels
steps.title_cn: 方向性系数的 dB 表示
steps.explanation: Convert dimensionless directivity to decibels using $10\log_{10}(\cdot)$
steps.explanation_cn: 使用 $10\log_{10}(\cdot)$ 将无量纲方向性系数转换为分贝值
